definitions.explanation: A crack or network of fine splits in a surface such as a wall, dried ground, ceramics, or chapped skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ひび{割|わ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A crack forms in the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ひび{割|わ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Cracks formed on my skin from the dryness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外壁|がいへき}→外壁：06426_gaiheki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ひび{割|わ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られた→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: Cracks could be seen here and there on the outer walls of the old building.

notes:
ひび (a hairline crack) + ⟦{割|わ}れ→割る：02334_waru⟧ (a break, split). Refers to fine cracks in surfaces such as walls, dried ground, ceramics, or chapped skin. The verb form is ひび{割|わ}れる (to crack; to become chapped).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ひび{割|わ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: a crack forms
- ひび{割|わ}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent cracking
- ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ひび{割|わ}れ: chapped skin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{亀裂|きれつ}→亀裂：09411_kiretsu⟧: crack, fissure — larger or more serious cracks; also figurative (a rift)
